g.text: how a tool call travels from the MCP client to Billingo · source file in (brackets)
Claude Code · Claude Desktop · code-mode host (scripts call tools)
1. tool groups: only the groups asked for (unknown name = error)
2. read / write scope: write tools only when allowed
3. register: input schema · output schema (17 reads) · annotations
7 tool groups · 49 tools (22 read, 27 write) · src/tools/
keeps structuredContent only for tools with an output schema
X-API-KEY · paging · retries only GETs (429, PDF not ready)
no rate-limit headers exist · documented 300 requests/min
tool call: { id, only the fields that change }
a missing or null field means "keep"
keep the write-model fields, drop nulls
(spending: read names mapped to write names)
nested objects key by key · arrays replace
product: send one price · spending: HUF amounts in step
Why: Billingo's PUT replaces the whole record and clears
what it leaves out. The read and the write are two requests:
a change made in Billingo in between is overwritten.
update_payment is different: it replaces the whole payment
list, so the caller reads the existing payments first.
